scope: Actual production four-tire solver, real graph/terrain/hazard contact, input-only route controller. Segment spawns isolate drivability; no pose/speed/fuel injection after spawn. Fuel demand measured from actual travel, compared to tank range; this is not a claim that a stock pickup can fuel a 1km segment.
limitations: Offline Node/Three.js, no browser or gameplay rendering
Independent segment drivability is separate from complete economy/fuel-depletion journeys
